# fixture-card + fixture-shape — a FIXTURE variation (not a real box)

## What this variation is

A **fixture**, not a deployment — the same invented `fixture-card` as its
sibling, with an invented deployment shape (`fixture-shape`) applied. The
shape drops a core role to a peer box, so the directory carries a
`docker-compose.shape.yml` overlay alongside the base compose file, and the
lock records `MULTIMODAL_FEASIBLE=false`.

Its purpose is to exercise the `<variation-id>__<shape>` directory-name form
and the UNMEASURED half of the info-file contract.

No hardware ran this. Nothing here may be cited as a measurement of anything.

## Measured result

No measured result.

This is the state most of the real catalog will be in on day one. CLAUDE.md's
issue #108 rule keeps a shape DECLARED until an acceptance transcript lands,
and all four Orin shapes plus `thor-muse` have none. Saying so in these exact
words — rather than leaving the section empty — is what stops a reader from
mistaking a blank for a measurement.
